_markedDoc: statuses.marked: Quarry (the ranged perk node) and Branding (a tier-3 skill talent) both hang this on a target. It is a plain takeMore debuff, so js/skills.js buffsOf already knows what to do with it; each caller passes its own seconds and share, so this row is the default and the name the log prints.
_descDoc: EVERY `desc` BELOW IS GENERATED, NOT WRITTEN. `js/skills.js` `describeSkill(skill, statuses)` builds each line out of that skill's own `mult`, `reach`, `arc`, `radius`, `range`, `splash`, `width`, `projectiles`, `spread`, `heal`, `status`, `mp` and `cooldown`, and out of the `statuses` row the skill names — so a description cannot promise something the numbers do not do. The text is stored here as well as generated so the screens that read this file directly (js/classbuild-ui.js, js/followers-ui.js, js/newgame.js) are right before any skill bar is built; `describeSkills(data)` runs at the top of `createSkillBar` and rewrites all forty anyway, so changing a number here changes the card even if nobody regenerated the file. Do not hand-edit a `desc`: change the number, or change `describeSkill`.
_doc: Farhold's skill bar (round 4). Emberveil's skills are written for a turn-based party fight ('adjacent2', 'row', 'per_source'), which does not translate to one person in real time, so these are its ideas rebuilt around a shape, a radius and a cooldown. Each class gets SIX, on keys 1-6, unlocked at the levels in `unlockAt` — so a new character has one button and earns the rest. `element` picks the spell effect from avatar-3d/js/spellfx.js. `projectiles` on a bolt fires that many at once in a fan `spread` radians wide — a multi shot that fires one arrow is not a multi shot. Shapes: melee (an arc in front), around (a ring centred on you), bolt (flies where you look), beam (a line), ground (lands where you are looking), dash (you move, everything on the way is hit), self (you), summon (a temporary companion).

power_strike.name: Power Strike
power_strike.desc: Strikes everything in a 92° arc 3.4 m in front of you for 190% weapon damage. No mana cost, 4s cooldown.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.desc: Strikes everything within 4.5 m of you for 115% weapon damage. 6 mana, 7s cooldown.

sunder.name: Sunder
sunder.desc: Strikes everything in an 80° arc 3.2 m in front of you for 160% weapon damage. Leaves the target Weakened: the target deals 35% less damage for 7s. 8 mana, 9s cooldown.

shield_bash.name: Shield Bash
shield_bash.desc: Strikes everything in a 126° arc 2.8 m in front of you for 130% weapon damage. Leaves the target Snared: the target moves 80% slower for 3s. 6 mana, 8s cooldown.

whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.desc: Strikes everything within 5.5 m of you for 160% weapon damage. 14 mana, 12s cooldown.

charge.name: Charge
charge.desc: Carries you 12 m forward, striking everything within 2.4 m of your path for 170% weapon damage. 10 mana, 10s cooldown.

execute.name: Execute
execute.desc: Strikes everything in a 69° arc 3 m in front of you for 320% weapon damage. 12 mana, 14s cooldown.

aimed_shot.name: Aimed Shot
aimed_shot.desc: Looses one shot out to 42 m for 220% weapon damage, splashing everything within 1.2 m of where the shot lands. 4 mana, 5s cooldown.

multi_shot.name: Multi Shot
multi_shot.desc: Looses 5 shots in an 11° fan out to 34 m, each for 80% weapon damage, splashing everything within 1.6 m of where a shot lands. 10 mana, 8s cooldown.

pinning_shot.name: Pinning Shot
pinning_shot.desc: Looses 2 shots in a 5° fan out to 38 m, each for 100% weapon damage, splashing everything within 1.4 m of where a shot lands. Leaves the target Snared: the target moves 80% slower for 3s. 8 mana, 9s cooldown.

rain_of_arrows.name: Rain of Arrows
rain_of_arrows.desc: Falls on a spot up to 32 m away, striking everything within 6.5 m of that spot for 150% weapon damage. 16 mana, 14s cooldown.

poison_dart.name: Poison Dart
poison_dart.desc: Looses one bolt out to 34 m for 110% weapon damage as poison, splashing everything within 1.5 m of where the bolt lands. Leaves the target Poisoned: a further 144% weapon damage over 8s. 6 mana, 5s cooldown.

shadowstep.name: Shadow Step
shadowstep.desc: Carries you 14 m forward, striking everything within 2 m of your path for 210% weapon damage as shadow. 10 mana, 9s cooldown.

eviscerate.name: Eviscerate
eviscerate.desc: Strikes everything in a 63° arc 2.8 m in front of you for 240% weapon damage. Leaves the target Bleeding: a further 131% weapon damage over 6s. 8 mana, 7s cooldown.

smoke.name: Smoke
smoke.desc: Gives you Hastened: you attack 45% faster and move 30% faster for 10s. 12 mana, 20s cooldown.

firebolt.name: Firebolt
firebolt.desc: Looses one bolt out to 36 m for 160% weapon damage as fire, splashing everything within 2.6 m of where the bolt lands. Leaves the target Burning: a further 84% weapon damage over 5s. 8 mana, 4s cooldown.

fire_wall.name: Ember Field
fire_wall.desc: Falls on a spot up to 30 m away, striking everything within 6 m of that spot for 180% weapon damage as fire. Leaves the target Burning: a further 95% weapon damage over 5s. 18 mana, 13s cooldown.

frost_nova.name: Frost Nova
frost_nova.desc: Strikes everything within 6 m of you for 120% weapon damage as ice. Leaves the target Chilled: the target moves 45% slower for 4s. 14 mana, 9s cooldown.

ice_lance.name: Ice Lance
ice_lance.desc: Fires a 1.8 m wide beam 26 m straight ahead, striking everything in the line for 190% weapon damage as ice. Leaves the target Chilled: the target moves 45% slower for 4s. 12 mana, 7s cooldown.

chain_bolt.name: Chain Bolt
chain_bolt.desc: Looses 3 bolts in an 8° fan out to 40 m, each for 110% weapon damage as lightning, splashing everything within 3.2 m of where a bolt lands. Leaves the target Shocked: the target takes 30% more damage for 5s. 12 mana, 7s cooldown.

thunderclap.name: Thunderclap
thunderclap.desc: Strikes everything within 7 m of you for 170% weapon damage as lightning. Leaves the target Shocked: the target takes 30% more damage for 5s. 18 mana, 12s cooldown.

storm_beam.name: Storm Beam
storm_beam.desc: Fires a 2.4 m wide beam 30 m straight ahead, striking everything in the line for 220% weapon damage as lightning. 20 mana, 11s cooldown.

shadow_lance.name: Shadow Lance
shadow_lance.desc: Looses one bolt out to 38 m for 190% weapon damage as shadow, splashing everything within 2 m of where the bolt lands. 10 mana, 5s cooldown.

curse.name: Curse
curse.desc: Looses one bolt out to 34 m for 80% weapon damage as shadow, splashing everything within 5 m of where the bolt lands. Leaves the target Cursed: the target takes 25% more damage and moves 15% slower for 8s. 14 mana, 12s cooldown.

drain.name: Drain
drain.desc: Fires a 1.6 m wide beam 22 m straight ahead, striking everything in the line for 150% weapon damage as shadow. Heals you for 12% of the damage dealt. 12 mana, 9s cooldown.

arcane_burst.name: Arcane Burst
arcane_burst.desc: Falls on a spot up to 34 m away, striking everything within 5 m of that spot for 230% weapon damage as arcane. 18 mana, 10s cooldown.

meteor.name: Fallstone
meteor.desc: Falls on a spot up to 36 m away, striking everything within 8 m of that spot for 340% weapon damage as fire. Leaves the target Burning: a further 179% weapon damage over 5s. 30 mana, 22s cooldown.

mend.name: Mend
mend.desc: Heals you for 35% of your maximum health. 18 mana, 14s cooldown.

renew.name: Renew
renew.desc: Gives you Mending: heals 25% of your maximum health over 10s. Everything following you is mended with you. 14 mana, 16s cooldown.

warcry.name: War Cry
warcry.desc: Gives you Might: you deal 30% more damage for 12s. 10 mana, 22s cooldown.

guard_stance.name: Guard
guard_stance.desc: Gives you Guarded: you take 45% less damage for 8s. 8 mana, 18s cooldown.

stoneskin.name: Stoneskin
stoneskin.desc: Gives you Stoneskin: you gain 60 armour for 14s. 14 mana, 24s cooldown.

quicken.name: Quicken
quicken.desc: Gives you Hastened: you attack 45% faster and move 30% faster for 10s. 16 mana, 26s cooldown.

rally.name: Rally
rally.desc: Gives you Rallied: you deal 20% more damage and take 15% less damage for 8s. Everything following you gets the same. 18 mana, 30s cooldown.

consecrate.name: Consecrate
consecrate.desc: Strikes everything within 6.5 m of you for 140% weapon damage as holy. Heals you for 15% of your maximum health. 20 mana, 16s cooldown.

raise_thrall.name: Raise Thrall
raise_thrall.desc: Summons 1 Bone Thrall to fight beside you. 20 mana, 26s cooldown.

call_wolf.name: Call the Pack
call_wolf.desc: Summons 1 Grove Wolf to fight beside you. 18 mana, 26s cooldown.

call_spirit.name: Call a Spirit
call_spirit.desc: Summons 1 Spirit Bear to fight beside you. 26 mana, 40s cooldown.

bind_imp.name: Bind a Fiend
bind_imp.desc: Summons 1 Bound Imp to fight beside you. 22 mana, 32s cooldown.

deploy_sentry.name: Deploy Sentry
deploy_sentry.desc: Summons 1 Clockwork Sentry to fight beside you. 20 mana, 30s cooldown.
